entries.text: Hello, everyone. Let’s have a fun class today.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_01

entries.text: Did you make sure to review last class’s material\nin order to stay “sharp”?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_02

entries.text: I know it was a little difficult with all that talk of\nmultiplication and percentages and the like.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_03

entries.text: But today, we’ll be talking about percentages\nagain to learn about probability.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_04

entries.text: That may sound like we’re going to have another\ndifficult class, but did you know that all of you\r\nalready deal with probability on a regular basis?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_05

entries.text: Pokémon moves generally have a property called\naccuracy, which determines the probability that\r\nthey will hit.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_06

entries.text: The accuracy of Tackle is 100—or 100 percent.\nSo if you were to use Tackle 100 times, you\r\ncould expect it to hit all 100 times![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_07

entries.text: The move Hypnosis, which puts opponents to\nsleep, has an accuracy of 60—or 60 percent.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_08

entries.text: That means you could expect it to hit 60 times\nin 100 uses. To put that another way—out of 100\r\nuses, you could expect it to miss 40 times![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_09

entries.text: Many of the truly powerful moves often tend to\nhave lower accuracy.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_10

entries.text: So when you’re deciding whether to go slow and\nsteady with moves that are sure to hit, or hard\r\nand fast with stronger but less accurate moves...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_11

entries.text: you’re already studying probability![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_12

entries.text: Let me see here... Perhaps Surf and Hydro Pump\nwould be good examples for this discussion?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_13

entries.text: Surf has a power of 90. Its accuracy is 100,\nmeaning you can expect it to hit every time.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_14

entries.text: Hydro Pump’s accuracy is only 80—but when it\nhits, its power is 110![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_15

entries.text: So, between Surf and Hydro Pump, which move\nwould you want to use yourselves?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_16

entries.text: I’d use Surf
entries.label: class_b_06_select_01

entries.text: I’d use Hydro Pump
entries.label: class_b_06_select_02

entries.text: It depends on the situation
entries.label: class_b_06_select_03

entries.text: Oh my. I see it’s “slow and steady wins the race”\nfor you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_answer_01

entries.text: Oh my. I see you like the risky, adventurous side\nof things, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_answer_02

entries.text: Oh my. I see you’re always considering various\npossibilities, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_answer_03

entries.text: I may have made it sound like there was a correct\nanswer here, but there’s not!\c\nYou’re free to use any moves you wish![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_17

entries.text:
Factors like PP or number of targets hit may make
some moves more suited to certain situations.\c
However, trading accuracy for power or vice
versa is purely a matter of preference![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_18

entries.text: This Surf-versus-Hydro Pump debate has been\nongoing for quite some time.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_19

entries.text: Personally, I’m more invested in debating the\nRock-type moves Rock Slide and Stone Edge.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_20

entries.text: Let me tell you, I could get really worked up\ntalking about those moves, but—\c\nOh, my. There’s the bell. What a shame.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_21

entries.text: Next class will be the last of our time together,\nso show up 100 percent ready to go![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_06_math_22
